messages.content: Calculate the final velocity of a moving object given initial velocity of 20 m/s, acceleration of 5 m/s^2 and time of 6 seconds. Also, compute the total distance covered by the object.

function.name: kinematics_distance_traveled
function.description: Computes the total distance covered by a moving object given initial velocity, acceleration and time. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

initial_velocity.description: The initial velocity of the object in m/s. This is a float type value.

acceleration.description: The acceleration of the object in m/s^2. This is a float type value.

time.description: The time for which the object has been moving in seconds. This is a float type value.
